dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid linear narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical lateral protrusion visible on the right margin; left margin exhibits a more uniform curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible longitudinal skin folds or shallow depressions along the dorsal surface.
